I was responsible for the entire process—from AI-powered summarization, automated replies, and knowledge search to integration with external services, as well as backend API design and deployment.

desc_en: We created design mockups for “MEDIRISE,” a talent matching service that connects healthcare facilities with medical professionals. We implemented features such as job searches by job type, location, and work style; user registration and login; and the ability to save jobs of interest. By designing a color scheme tailored to each user group and optimizing the site for smartphones, we built a website that allows users to move seamlessly from job searches to applications and registration.

desc_en: Using WordPress, we created a sample design website for “Hitomado Co., Ltd.,” a shared housing management company operating in Osaka, Kyoto, Kobe, and Nara. We implemented features such as area search via map, displays of vacancy status and rent for each property, and a design that clearly distinguishes the company’s three brands. We also organized the move-in process and FAQs to build a website that allows users to move seamlessly from comparing properties to scheduling viewings and making inquiries about moving in.

desc_en: We developed the corporate website for “Yuimado Co., Ltd.,” a company operating 14 businesses in Kawagoe City, Saitama Prefecture. Through a structure that clearly organizes its diverse business operations in an at-a-glance format and a sleek design, we designed a user flow that allows visitors to smoothly access their desired services. We also implemented responsive design, a news feed feature, and on-page SEO optimization.

name: TIDEWELL HOTEL｜予約と会員ページを備えた海辺のホテルのサイトを制作

desc_en: We created a design sample site for “TIDEWELL HOTEL,” a seaside hotel in Momochihama, Fukuoka. Featuring a design that showcases the appeal of the ocean-view guest rooms through photographs, along with sections highlighting the guest rooms, on-site facilities, a reservation form, and a members-only page, we designed a user flow that builds anticipation for the stay while ensuring a smooth path from the official website to making a reservation.

name: EAVES｜シンプルで心地いい家づくりが伝わる工務店のサイトを制作

desc_en: We created a design showcase website for “EAVES Co., Ltd.,” a construction company based in Kurume City. Featuring a calm design centered on bronze and black tones, a full-width photo slider, a fixed side menu, and smooth scrolling effects, the site conveys the company’s philosophy on homebuilding and the appeal of its project examples, while guiding visitors naturally toward requesting brochures, booking open house tours, and submitting inquiries.

desc: WordPressを活用し、建築設計事務所「結 -yui-」のデザインサンプルサイトを制作し、余白を活かした洗練されたデザインと大判の建築写真を中心に、作品ごとの背景や設計思想が伝わる構成を実現するとともに、レスポンシブ対応、SEO内部対策、SSL・セキュリティ対策、表示速度の最適化、お問い合わせフォームの設置まで対応しました。
desc_en: Using WordPress, we created a sample design website for the architectural design firm “Yui.” Focusing on a sophisticated design that makes effective use of white space and features large-format architectural photographs, we developed a layout that effectively conveys the background and design philosophy behind each project. We also implemented responsive design, on-page SEO, SSL and security measures, page speed optimization, and the installation of a contact form.

The tool includes features such as storyboard generation, panel layout and dialogue editing, speech bubble editing, PNG and PDF export, and the ability to save and load projects.

We used a clean color scheme and reassuring copy to alleviate anxiety among first-time patients, while also optimizing navigation to clinic information, hours of operation, directions, and phone/online appointment booking.
